g.text: N = 16,384; B = 64 B; 2,048 warmup + 4,096 measured commands per window.
Five preselected adjacent windows per trace. Whiskers: observed min-max, not confidence intervals.
Counts all frontend/backend, authentication, maintenance and padding bytes in the implemented variants.
Command start keys only; original I/O sizes and arrival times are not replayed. No native-system or latency claim.
